name: Busa Drama

agentPrompts.label: Show me the production health dashboard
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-drama` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize the series health, execution timeline, and per-episode script/storyboard/shot readiness stats.

agentPrompts.label: What needs my attention before generating more assets?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-drama` skill in this folder, then tell me which characters are missing reference cards and which shots fail the video-ready Definition of Done, so I know what to fix before spending on image or video generation.

agentPrompts.label: Seed a starter project to explore the workspace
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-drama` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then, if the workspace is empty, seed it with the bundled sample project so I can explore the series bible, characters, episodes, and shots before starting my own.
